tasks.prompt:
Case A - Inspect the mock bay

A classroom wall mockup must be checked against Issued Drawing A. Use the supplied survey below, or a teacher-verified physical mockup with its own survey. These numbers are simulated teaching data, not a survey of the fieldhouse. The lower-left outside corner is the datum. All dimensions are inches. Length/position specifications have +/-1/8 inch tolerance. The pipe OD note must match the supplied material reference.

| Feature | Issued specification | Supplied survey |
|---|---|---|
| Overall width | 48 +/-1/8 | 48 1/16 |
| Overall height | 96 +/-1/8 | 96 |
| Opening width | 16 +/-1/8 | 15 3/4 |
| Opening left edge x | 16 +/-1/8 | 16 1/4 |
| Service center x | 40 +/-1/8 | 40 1/16 |
| Service outside diameter | Drawing note: 2 | Reference: 2 3/8 |

1. Write the purpose, constraints, evidence source and information still missing before a real job.
2. Complete an inspection table: feature, spec/interval, reading, signed deviation, in/out and amount outside.
3. Produce an as-built elevation with corrected positions/dimensions and service note. Add an appropriate section or orthographic view to clarify one interface.
4. Write a short inspection note identifying what changes and why. Distinguish a material-label error from a tolerance failure.

Revision: Repeat one personally measured feature with a checked reference, or correct the supplied-data interval calculation; submit a revised drawing and explain exactly how the new evidence changed the decision.

tasks.prompt:
Case B - Route the drain through the service zone

This is a dry classroom coordination model, not an installation approval or permission to alter framing. Original horizontal run is 18 ft; available service-zone depth is 8 in. Required slope is at least 1/4 in/ft. Pipe OD is 2 3/8 in. Minimum top and bottom clearances are 3/4 in each. All vertical dimensions use the zone top as datum. Two changes may be proposed for review: shorten the run to 16 ft, or deepen the zone to 8 1/2 in while keeping the 18-ft run. Other fittings, access and connections are not specified.

| Condition | Value |
|---|---|
| Original horizontal run | 18 ft |
| Available zone depth | 8 in |
| Required slope | 1/4 in/ft minimum |
| Pipe outside diameter | 2 3/8 in |
| Top / bottom clearance | 3/4 in each |
| Alternative 1 | 16-ft run; 8-in zone |
| Alternative 2 | 18-ft run; 8 1/2-in zone |

1. List fixed requirements and the two changes available for review.
2. Calculate original fall, required depth and quantified conflict. Reject an unsupported slope reduction.
3. Evaluate both alternatives, including remaining depth margin.
4. Draw a plan and longitudinal section for your proposed route: flow, horizontal run, slope, datum, elevations and outside envelope.
5. Write an RFI explaining what another trade must confirm before the proposal could be used.

Revision: Correct the complete depth budget, add missing dimensions to both views, and test the selected route against the stated constraints. Submit a revision note showing which previous claim changed.
